cccd.tip1: The photo must be sharp, no glare or clipped edges.

cccd.privacyNotice: Per Vietnam's Decree 13/2023/ND-CP and Personal Data Protection Law 2025: your Citizen ID image is used solely to verify your identity and to be embedded into the e-signed contract (as required by the Law on Electronic Transactions 2023, Article 12). Immediately after embedding, the original image file is deleted from our storage; it is not copied, not shared with any third party, and not used for analytics or marketing.

passport.modalDescription: Please upload a photo of your passport information page (the page with your photo and passport number) to verify your identity before signing the contract.

passport.tip2: Avoid glare; make sure the passport is valid at least through the end of the contract.
passport.privacyNotice: Per Vietnam's Decree 13/2023/ND-CP and Personal Data Protection Law 2025: your passport image is used solely to verify your identity and to be embedded into the e-signed contract (as required by the Law on Electronic Transactions 2023, Article 12). Immediately after embedding, the original image file is deleted from our storage; it is not copied, not shared with any third party, and not used for analytics or marketing.

termsModal.title: Terms and conditions
termsModal.loadError: Could not load contract content. Please try again.
termsModal.platformIntro: By signing electronically on the ISUMS platform you agree to the following terms of the digital signing service:
termsModal.platformItem1: Digital signatures are generated through the VNPT eContract service and are legally binding under the 2023 Law on Electronic Transactions and Decree 130/2018/ND-CP.
termsModal.platformItem2: The OTP code sent via email/SMS authenticates the signer's identity. Do not share it. Each code is single-use and only valid for the stated period.
termsModal.platformItem3: ID card / passport images are used solely to verify identity and to be attached to the signed contract; the original image files are then deleted from storage in accordance with Decree 13/2023/ND-CP.
termsModal.platformItem4: Signing audit records (timestamp, IP, processCode, document hash) are retained to support audit trails and dispute resolution; they are not used for advertising or external analytics.
termsModal.platformItem5: By ticking the confirmation box and pressing Continue, you confirm that you have read, understood and agreed to the contract content above as well as these signing-platform terms.
